items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I used to play at the Arab beef packing company parade with him every corner of the day... I used to play with him regularly too

ctx.x: happened. I don't know what happened to Poisey. Well, tell us about Maurice Duran.

Maurice Duran. Maurice Duran. Maurice Duran used to play with my, well, Maurice Duran used to have, him and Willie Humphries have a band together. Duran and Humphrey, when I was playing with Celestan and Rizley. Duran and Humphrey. Celestan and Rizley. Yeah. A lot of times we used to play with two bands. Yeah, Celestan and Humphrey. But after that, when I joined, when I joined, when I joined, uh, Ma'am Perez, Maurice Duran was playing with Ma'am Perez. Second trumpet. Yeah. He's not playing. He's not playing at…
time ago. His father died. I saw him in California. I know him. You met him? Yeah. Two years ago, I saw him. Yeah. He was a good trumpet player. Yeah.

items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Maurice Durand. Eddie Cherie... Yeah, I was playing Alton and Clannet.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, who's all in the band? The members of the band? Oh, who's playing with the band? Yeah.

Oh, they had Des Dune, not Des Dune. Maurice Durand. Eddie Cherie. Eddie Cherie was playing tenor. Tenor and Clannet. Yeah, I was playing Alton and Clannet. We had Kaffer who was playing banjo. And Mercy D, we used to play piano, but she quit. And the school professor. I see all the blanchets. I see all the blanchets, yeah. He played for a long time. And Willie Humphrey's brother was playing. Poison.
